text:
Olga K.: Kicking off asia-east3 bring-up for the GPU pool. Primary goals: GitOps app per-cluster, mirrored image registry in-region, and replication validation. Timeline: today-ish.
Sam T.: Re: mirrored registry — are we using signed images (cosign) or just pull-through cache?
Olga K.: Prefer signed images in the target registry. But we can do a short-term pull-through cache to unblock tests. Plan: replicate signed artifacts nightly + on-push hooks.
Jay P.: For GitOps, I'll create an ArgoCD app per region. Minimal helm values to override registry host:
```yaml
image:
  repository: asia-east3-reg.example.com/redwood/runtime
  tag: v2026-03-18-canary
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
```
Olga K.: Good. Also enabling `imagePullSecrets` with our registry robot account. I'll add RBAC for the robot.
Maria S.: Heads-up: cross-region replication costs are nontrivial. Estimate for 2TB/day -> ~$700/day egress if we pull from us-central. Need to pre-stage into the local registry to avoid egress spikes.
Sam T.: How do we validate replication integrity? checksum? cosign verify?
Jay P.: We run two checks: cosign verify sig, then `skopeo inspect --config docker://asia-east3-reg.example.com/redwood/runtime:TAG` compare digest to origin. I can add a small job that posts results to the GitOps PR.
Olga K.: Add an automated smoke deploy after replication: helm upgrade --install + simple readiness probe hitting /live. If it fails, rollback and open an incident.
Olga K.: Drafting the runbook snippets now. Outline: 1) bootstrap registry 2) robot account + secrets 3) enable replication jobs 4) valids checks 5) handoff to infra-oncall.
ops-oncall: Question — do we need VPC peering or Private Service Connect for the registry? GCP quotas in asia-east3 are strict.
Maria S.: Use Private Service Connect to keep egress local and avoid public egress. We'll need subnet allocation — pinging infra networking to reserve.
Sam T.: For GitOps, naming convention: `argocd-app/region/cluster` and app labels `region=asia-east3, stage=canary`. Keeps each cluster independent.
Jay P.: ArgoCD app manifest example (snippet):
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: runtime-asia-east3
spec:
  project: redwood-infra
  source:
    repoURL: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/helm-charts.git
    path: charts/runtime
    targetRevision: main
    helm:
      values: |
        image.repository=asia-east3-reg.example.com/redwood/runtime
        image.tag=v2026-03-18-canary
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: runtime
```
Olga K.: Nice. Add `syncPolicy: automated` with `prune: true` for the initial bootstrap. We'll flip to manual post-handoff.
deploy-bot: replication-job/asia-east3 completed: 42 artifacts replicated, 0 failures. duration=18m
Sam T.: deploy-bot — did the job run cosign verification?
deploy-bot: replication-job/asia-east3 verified: 42 signatures OK. checksums matched origin digests.
Maria S.: Great. Can we configure TTL on old tags to reduce storage? e.g., keep last 30 tags per repo.
Jay P.: Registry lifecycle rule example: keep last 30, delete untagged older than 7d. I'll open a PR against the harbor config.
Olga K.: Validation checklist for handoff to oncall: 1) ArgoCD app healthy 2) registry robot key in secret store 3) replication job in cron namespace + success history 4) cosign keys rotated and stored 5) smoke pods passed readiness 6) network egress checks < threshold.
ops-oncall: I need exact runbook steps to take ownership. Can you paste into the incidents playbook when ready?
Olga K.: Will do. I'll add runbook steps under `infra/regions/asia-east3/playbooks/registry-bootstrap.md` and ping you.
Sam T.: One more: metrics to watch — registry replication failures, cosign verification rate, image pull latency, egress bytes. Add dashboards and alerts.
Maria S.: I'll create a cost alert when daily egress projection > $200. Better to catch before it hits high numbers.
Jay P.: After handoff, we'll switch replication from on-push to batch-only at non-peak hours to control egress.
Olga K.: Thanks all. I'll push the initial ArgoCD manifests and the runbook fragments, then post the PR here. Call out any blockers asap. :thumbsup:
